select season, doy_bucket, index_id, avg(value) as avg_val, count(*) n
from (
  select avail_season as season, (avail_doy/30)::int as doy_bucket, index_id, value
  from climate
  where index_id in ('oni','pdo')
) 
group by 1,2,3 order by 3,1,2

select ts_season as season, avg(wtmp_c) avg_wtmp_c, count(*) n
from pier
where ts_doy <= 32
group by 1 order by 1
